Yes — here are two authoritative sources confirming the UN Charter was adopted in 1945:

- United Nations (official): "UN Charter" — background and history noting the Charter and the San Francisco Conference in 1945. ([un.org](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-charter?utm_source=openai))  
- Yale Law School, Avalon Project: text/record of "The Charter of the United Nations" (June 1945). ([avalon.law.yale.edu](https://avalon.law.yale.edu/subject_menus/decade.asp?utm_source=openai))
